title: Fair completion makes room for growth
meaning: Your union can create a rich continuation when fair completion of the familiar makes room for living care from you both.
text: Your partnership may find new warmth after respectfully completing an earlier phase. In the physical position, Justice expresses fair actions and responsibility for consequences. In energy, Death encourages closing an exhausted form and releasing effort. In emotions, the Empress enjoys growth, the fruits of attention and fullness in life. Ending need not dismiss what was done. Gratitude can remain alongside a wish to use released space differently. Both people can carry memories forward without requiring an old arrangement to remain permanently intact or a new form immediately to prove that every earlier effort was justified.

For example, you fairly sort objects from a shared hobby you no longer pursue. Treasured things remain and others are passed on. A freed corner gradually becomes a place for breakfast. **New pleasure can grow where something earlier was allowed to finish respectfully.** The space can be used without an immediate major project. Different memories can coexist with noticing good things available now, without completely forgetting the earlier chapter.

Busyness returns if released space must instantly prove change useful. You fill it, expand the idea and barely notice a peaceful result. Completion serves endless renewal and care becomes a burden again. Living fruitfulness allows a pause and a sufficiently good simple form. You need not stop missing something before enjoying the new, or assess every object identically in order to continue shared life fairly.
